notes.title: HELIBORNE: ENHANCED EDITION AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
Hi guys!

[i]Heliborne[/i] is one of the most successful Klabater's releases. Initially released in 2017, it remains one of the publisher’s flagships. Today we would love to let you know that the game just debuted in its ultimate shape!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33938074/b679693ecfa085b455b2ba8cff0639dc9f29d810.jpg[/img]

[i]Heliborne[/i], the Ultimate Helicopter Warfare Experience, is now taken to new heights as the game officially becomes [b][i]Heliborne: Enhanced Edition[/i][/b]! The game’s definitive edition brings not only tons of improvement and new content but also debuts at a new price (29,99 USD/EUR) for both the game and all DLCs included! 

--> Heliborne: Enhanced Edition [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/433530/Heliborne/]Steam Card[/url]
--> WATCH HELIBORNE ENHANCED EDITION[url=https://youtu.be/28X5Dn9Zw-0] TRAILER[/url]

From now on there is only one ‘Enhanced’ edition of the game containing the base game with all the DLCs released until now (over a dozen!) in the price of the regular game! [b]Klabater decided that all the gamers who already paid for the original edition will now receive Enhanced Edition and ALL DLCs for free[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33938074/67427e0114be9e46650b7dd2044510f40ded0839.jpg[/img]

[i]Heliborne: Enhanced Edition[/i] is the next big step for the franchise, meant as a final version of the [i]Heliborne[/i] game dedicated to those who love the game already but also for newcomers. It’s a brand new visual quality mixed with significant gameplay overhaul. The development team is now working on the console edition of Enhanced Edition, and more info will be revealed soon!

With [i]Heliborne: Enhanced Edition[/i], the Ultimate PC Helicopter Warfare Experience is now taken to new heights! 
[list]
[*] New Prototype Machines 
[*] Fully Upgraded Game Engine 
[*] New Day & Night Maps 
[*] Updated in-game Physics 
[*] Empowered Multiplayer Experience 
[*] Refreshed User Interface
[/list]
[b]As we promised to our community, all who have bought the game before will get the free update to Enhanced Edition! This is our way of saying thank you’ to all the community that helped us and supported us for years. So, even if you own the basic version of the game with no DLC installed, you will still get access to both the Enhanced Edition of the game and ALL DLCs released until now! Enjoy![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33938074/8df5edc6ebc48de7fbfd170c2c503e9d1c54e615.jpg[/img]
[b]WHAT’S IN IT FOR THE PLAYERS?[/b]

With Heliborne: Enhanced Edition players get the basic game and over a dozen of cool DLC at a very, very reasonable price. A summary of a player’s ‘savings’ below:
[list]
[*] The previous Heliborne price was 19,99 USD/EUR, and DLCs were altogether worth   54,85 USD/EUR... So, until now, the whole package cost 75 USD/EUR.
[*] From August 20, the 75 USD/EUR value content will be priced at 29,99 USD/EUR... As simple as that! You get EVERYTHING at once, and [b]you SAVE 60%[/b]! 
[/list]
KLABATER TEAM

notes.title: Play the demo + Support Help Will Come Tomorrow crowdfunding campaign!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33938074/86b7ab539c123be8cae35d4feab78aa8d9a32cc4.jpg[/img]

Friends!

We are happy to let you know that today we’ve launched a crowdfunding campaign for Help Will Come Tomorrow, a true-born survival game and another step in Klabater’s bold journey in search of meaningful, story-driven games. 

You will find our campaign here: klabater.com/HWCT_Kickstarter  

We encourage you to support the game! :)

We soooo are happy to finally unveil more details about Help Will Come Tomorrow. The game was shown during Gamescom 2019 previously, and we are now in a much more advanced stage of development. This is why we decided to add a demo, to let everyone know that Help Will Come Tomorrow is already in a good shape. We really think that we have found our own unique approach to survival game formula, with a more narrative-driven and psychological touch.

Help Will Come Tomorrow crowdfunding campaign is supported with many new game-related materials, among them screens and artwork, but above all else we encourage you to check: 
[list]
[*] Exclusive demo (first 3 days in the game, available on Steam Card of the game)
[*] New gameplay trailer
[/list]
https://youtu.be/UeaNRGK4GDc
[list]
[*] New Dev Diaries series:
[/list]
https://youtu.be/ERdxjWsiHh8
https://youtu.be/B0wHCqETQmE
https://youtu.be/iX3I7_YYvfg

Help us spread the word and share this news if you can :) Our fellow devs from Arclight Creations are now at the finish of development, but Help Will Come Tomorrow definitely requires extra help. Thanks to your support creators will be able to secure a top notch quality for the release!

Arclight Creations & Klabater

notes.title: Free DLC, more gameplay, more languages and more fixes - PATCH 6 is here!

tags.feature: “Roboto Factory” is a free DLC that lets you get inside the famous Roboto Factory, where all the bots you've met on Speculo were created. You will discover its workings and see your old mechanical companions in a new light.
We’ve also added the support for both simplified and traditional Chinese - now not only you can enjoy the game with Chinese subtitles but also with Chinese text within the game world!

tags.bug: Fixed the achievement “Get 6600 units of graphene” - now it should unlock properly;
Fixed the occasional issue with incorrect display of subtitles;

tags.feature: Added the option to turn off the vibration on gamepads;
Added the option to reset your save files, so you can restart the level you’re currently in. In the main menu just press LCTRL+LSHIFT+F5 and listen for a sound indicating that the reset is done.

notes.title: AN UPDATE THIS WAY COMES!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 
We know it's been a while since the last patch. The devs from Carbon Studio are working on another big one containing fixes, more gameplay, and additional localization. This is still TBA however, although it should come out soon - we'll roll it out as soon as it's ready. 

For now we have something somewhat unexpected for you - [b]support for Linux[/b]. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26478003/c1ac12db661c0853ccb6ea0846436d6450c7c257.jpg[/img]

In short, if you have a machine running Steam OS, you can enjoy ALICE. 

We know that this is not what many of you are waiting for, but it's a start of a new roll-out of content. 

Thank you for being with us!

notes.title: LOOK WHAT THE CAT DRAGGED IN - IT'S PATCH 4!

tags.feature: [*]Added a teleport system to the game. It’s entirely optional and you can find it, unsurprisingly, in the options menu. It’s the point-to-click sort where you freely choose the location you want to go (instead of moving to a predetermined zone). It works with Oculus Rift and HTC Vive;

tags.bug: [*]Fixed the OSVR support for the newest HMD, just choose one of the HDK2 compatibility modes while starting the application. There’s one caveat though - HMD scaling (supersampling) is currently unavailable on OSVR;

tags.feature: [*]Broader support for unsupported devices. Now the game launcher will be giving you six choices instead of the usual three. If you happen to have an HMD [b]that is not[/b] of the Oculus-Vive-OSVR variety, you can now choose one of the new compatibility modes and (fingers crossed) everything will be working. No guarantees but we believe in many cases that should do the trick;

tags.bug: [*]Fixed the issues with game saves. We’ve tested it extensively to find the cause of the problem and the saves you’ve provided were of huge help to us. Now both saving and loading works as intended;
[*]Changed the locations of several checkpoints, so no Alice will be trapped in a no-win scenario ever again;
[*]Snap turning on HTC Vive will no longer cause you to move backwards, so now everyone can follow Pop’s mantra: “Never backwards, always forward”;
[*]Fixed all discovered causes of players getting out of bounds, because in the game of croquet everyone needs to stay in the play area;

tags.feature: [*]Now on HTC Vive you can use both motion controllers [b]and[/b] a gamepad, so even if your HTC Vive is the off-brand type, you can still play Alice VR;

tags.bug: [*]The camera position on HTC Vive has been brought in line with its position on Oculus Rift. Yeah, it’s a weird thing to mention in patch notes, I know;

[*]Fixed achievements (On Foot, Grown a Conscience, Greedy, Carbon Footprint, Mommy?). Now the system works faster, is shinier, and in case it bugged out on you the first time, you’ll be able to get the missing achievements on your second go-round;
[*]Fixed collision issues, especially on ramps. Ramps are tricky;

tags.feature: [*]Enhanced lighting effects in the City.

notes.title: THE PATCH IS UP! (issues resolved & things tweaked)
notes.content:
Our first patch is here! 
First of all, thank you for supporting us and staying with us through this rocky start. Although things weren’t all smooth from the get go, this first update should put us on the right track. We truly appreciate your feedback, so please keep it up! 

Now, let’s see what’s changed... 

[h1]The BIG stuff:[/h1] 
[list]
[*][b]added the requested option to change the HMD scaling (supersampling) on HTC Vive and Oculus Rift. Now you have the choice between 0.80x, 1.00x and 1.50x;[/b]
[*][b]graphics settings are now being saved properly, yay![/b]
[*]the same goes for your language settings - on occasion they could default to your Steam language. No more. 
[/list]

[h1]The less big stuff:[/h1] 
[list][*]screen mirroring on HTC Vive should now work properly;
[*]some on-screen text and controller description fixes;
[*]fixed an issue during the encounter with the Hatter;
[*]Polish audio is no longer being selected automatically;
[*]tutorial messages are now turned on by default.[/list]

[h1]The new stuff:[/h1] 
[list][*]if you’re playing Alice in VR, as you should, you now have the option to turn off strafing and backwards movement (toggled in the options menu). All in the interest of your comfort and well-being; 
[*]added the option to make 90 degrees turns on gamepads and HTC Vive controllers, because everyone should be able to play how they want to.[/list] 


[b]Thank you all for your patience and let us know what you think! 
Enjoy Alice VR![/b]
